attributes.action: Make Air conditioning Mandatory in all schools and Nursery’s in the UK.
attributes.additional_details: Let’s make air conditioning Mandatory in all schools and nursery’s in the UK. This should be a basic requirement. Our summers are getting hotter and longer. My son aged 3 collapsed at pre school today due to the heat, he lost unconsciousness for a few seconds and has been in A&E since midday today. We are now being discharged as he has improved but now my concern is sending him back to school. I am a full time working Mum so it becomes difficult in terms of childcare. This needs to change!
attributes.background: I have tried to find a similar petition about making air conditioning mandatory in all schools and nursery’s in the UK, however every one I have come across has either been rejected or closed. The government need to take this seriously and make air conditioning mandatory in schools and nurserys.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petitions, which call for similar action:

Require & Fund Air Conditioning in all early years settings
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/775012

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023
